name: Catalyst Environment Reasoning QA 17
description: Dependency ordering question about correct workflow sequence

examples.input:
An agent is tasked with creating a CH4-adsorbed Ni(111) slab structure. The agent has access to the following tools and must determine the correct execution order:

Available operations (unordered):
  P: write_file('slab_with_ch4.cif', final_cif)
  Q: get_structure_from_mp_text('mp-23') -> ni_bulk_cif
  R: choose_adsorption_site_text(sites_json, 'hollow_fcc', 0) -> site_coords
  S: enumerate_slabs_text(ni_bulk_cif, [1,1,1], 12, 15) -> slabs_json
  T: get_structure_from_mp_text('mp-6701') -> ch4_cif
  U: add_adsorbate_to_slab_text(slab_cif, ch4_cif, 2.5, site_coords) -> final_cif
  V: choose_slab_text(slabs_json, 0) -> slab_cif
  W: get_adsorption_sites_text(slab_cif) -> sites_json

Which of the following represents a valid execution order that respects all data dependencies?
